descriptionChirho: Qal sense: to go down, come down, descend, or penetrate deeper into something.
Nifal sense: to sink down into, be thrust or driven in, as arrows or stakes fixed into something.
Nifal sense: to be broken down or shattered, expressing destruction or crushing.
Piel intensive sense: to press down, bend low, or cause to settle by force or weight.
Hifil causative sense: to cause to come down, bring down, or send down from above.
